fields.label: Email
fields.description: Contact email required by the Unpaywall API. See https://unpaywall.org/products/api.

actions.name: get_doi
actions.description: Retrieve Unpaywall open-access metadata for one DOI.

doi.description: The DOI identifier to retrieve, with or without a https://doi.org prefix.

record.description: An Unpaywall DOI object. Additional fields may be added by Unpaywall over time.

actions.name: search_articles
actions.description: Search Unpaywall articles by title text.

query.description: The title text to search for.

page.description: The one-based result page to retrieve. Each page contains up to 50 results.

isOa.description: Whether to return only articles that Unpaywall identifies as open access.

inputSchema.description: The Unpaywall article search query and optional page filters.

page.description: The one-based page requested from Unpaywall.

elapsedSeconds.description: The search duration in seconds reported by Unpaywall.

items.description: An Unpaywall search result containing a score and DOI response object.

results.description: The article search results returned for this page.

outputSchema.description: A page of Unpaywall article search results.
